assignments.title: Meta Ads Dynamic Campaign Architecture
assignments.description: Build an end-to-end Meta Ads campaign strategy deck including customer avatars, TOFU/MOFU/BOFU budget allocation, 3 creative mockups, and tracking pixel event triggers.

assignments.title: Brand Positioning & Full-Funnel Lead Gen Blueprint
assignments.description: Select a real or hypothetical business. Conduct competitor gap analysis, write Unique Value Proposition (UVP), and diagram a 3-stage acquisition funnel with estimated CPA targets.

assignments.title: First Keyword Research Audit & On-Page Checklist
assignments.description: Choose a local niche (e.g. Dental Clinic, Fitness Gym, Bakery). Find 10 high-intent keywords using Google Keyword Planner, write optimized Title & Meta Description, and submit your audit spreadsheet.

assignments.title: Live Project: Audit a Local Dental Clinic in Delhi
assignments.description: Perform local citation audit, identify missing NAP consistency, and recommend 5 optimizations.

assignments.title: Capstone 1: Midnight Basket Drop Analysis (NIDADS Official)
assignments.description: Analyze e-commerce cart abandonment between 11 PM and 4 AM using SQL window functions and Power BI. Identify UX bottlenecks, calculate lost gross merchandise value (GMV), and design automated retention nudge triggers.

assignments.title: Capstone 2: Dark Store Demand Twin (Hyperlocal Supply Chain)
assignments.description: Forecast 15-minute quick-commerce grocery demand across 15 fulfillment dark stores using Python and Power BI. Compute safety stock reorder levels to prevent stockouts during peak ordering hours.

assignments.title: Capstone 3: Airport Delay Storyboard & Flight Punctuality
assignments.description: Analyze 500,000+ flight records across major domestic hubs in Tableau. Correlate weather patterns and ground turnaround times to build an interactive executive aviation scoreboard.

assignments.title: Capstone 4: Hospital Readmission Radar (30-Day Clinical Triage)
assignments.description: Train a patient risk scoring dashboard flagging 30-day readmissions. Model clinical electronic health records (EHR) and provide actionable triage summaries for attending physicians.

assignments.title: Capstone 1: Fintech Credit Default Risk Underwriting Engine
assignments.description: Train an XGBoost and LightGBM loan default classifier on 250,000+ credit records. Integrate SHAP tree explainability values for regulatory compliance and deploy via a high-performance FastAPI endpoint.

assignments.title: Capstone 2: Computer Vision Medical Image Diagnosis with PyTorch
assignments.description: Fine-tune ResNet-50 on clinical chest X-ray scans. Generate Grad-CAM attention heatmaps highlighting pathology regions and compute sensitivity, specificity, and ROC-AUC metrics.

assignments.title: Capstone 3: Distributed E-Commerce Customer 360 with PySpark
assignments.description: Process 100+ GBs of raw user clickstream logs on Apache Spark. Write PySpark SQL window transformations, build Delta Lake ACID tables, and engineer batch features for model inference.

assignments.title: Capstone 4: Real-Time Streaming Fraud Detection Engine with Kafka
assignments.description: Construct a streaming fraud detection pipeline consuming Apache Kafka topics, executing sub-second PyTorch neural network inference, and publishing real-time fraud alerts to an operations dashboard.

assignments.title: Capstone 5: Generative AI & Clinical RAG Medical Assistant
assignments.description: Index medical clinical literature into Chroma vector database. Build a conversational RAG pipeline using LangChain, HuggingFace embeddings, and Mistral LLM with hallucination guardrails.

assignments.title: Capstone 1: Comprehensive Penetration Testing Report
assignments.description: Execute an end-to-end simulated penetration test against a multi-subnet enterprise environment using Nmap, Metasploit, and Burp Suite. Document technical vulnerabilities, exploit proof-of-concepts, CVSS 3.1 risk scores, and executive remediation strategies.

assignments.title: Capstone 2: Enterprise Incident Response Framework & Threat Hunting
assignments.description: Analyze enterprise log data following a ransomware outbreak. Construct Splunk search queries (SPL), correlate Windows event logs & Sysmon telemetry, map attacker techniques to MITRE ATT&CK, and author containment/eradication playbooks.

assignments.title: Capstone 3: Advanced Malware Reverse Engineering & YARA Signatures
assignments.description: Perform static and dynamic binary analysis on an obfuscated malware sample inside an isolated flare-vm sandbox. Disassemble key routines in IDA Pro / Ghidra, unpack payload stages, uncover C2 callback mechanisms, and formulate detection YARA rules.

assignments.title: Capstone 4: Cyber Crime Investigation & Forensic Evidence Dossier
assignments.description: Conduct forensic acquisition and analysis of compromised hard drive images and live memory dumps. Recover deleted artifacts, reconstruct timeline of exfiltration using Autopsy and Volatility, and generate a court-admissible forensic audit report.

assignments.title: Live Project 1: Meta Ads Brand Campaign & ROAS Optimization
assignments.description: Plan, launch, and optimize a live Facebook and Instagram ad campaign for a client brand — covering Meta Business Suite setup, custom audiences, ad creative copywriting, and ROAS performance reporting.

assignments.title: Live Project 2: Google Ads Search & Display Campaign Setup
assignments.description: Build and manage a live Google Ads campaign — covering keyword match types, negative keywords, responsive search ads, bidding strategy, and conversion tracking.

assignments.title: Live Project 3: SEO & Content Strategy Audit
assignments.description: Build a complete SEO and content strategy for an active brand — from technical site audit and keyword mapping to on-page optimization and Google Search Console tracking.

assignments.title: Live Project 4: WordPress E-Commerce / Lead Gen Site Build
assignments.description: Design and build a mobile-responsive WordPress website with Elementor, contact forms, speed optimization, and on-page SEO integration.

assignments.title: Live Project 5: Automated Email & WhatsApp Drip Sequences
assignments.description: Create an end-to-end automated email and WhatsApp nurture funnel in Mailchimp and WhatsApp Business API with audience segmentation and A/B split testing.

assignments.title: Capstone 5: Network Security Architecture Design & Hardening
assignments.description: Design and implement defense-in-depth security architecture for an enterprise network. Configure pfSense firewalls, establish Zero-Trust VLAN segmentations, tune Snort IDS/IPS detection rules, and perform deep packet inspection using Wireshark.

assignments.title: Capstone 6: Multi-Cloud Security Assessment & Automated Compliance
assignments.description: Deploy and audit multi-cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure. Implement CIS benchmark controls, configure AWS Security Hub & GuardDuty automated alerts, enforce least privilege IAM policies, and scan Terraform IaC templates for misconfigurations.
